name: agent-space
description: A local workbench for clear human–agent collaboration
author: AgentSpace contributors

scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:agent && tsx --test tests/contracts.test.ts tests/core/*.test.ts tests/ui/*.test.ts tests/desktop/unit.test.ts tests/desktop/local-unit.test.ts tests/protocol/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts "docs/**/*.md" "README*.md" AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md .agents/skills/agent-space-delivery/SKILL.md assets/packaging/START.md ".github/**/*.{md,yml,yaml}" package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.core.json tsconfig.desktop.json tsconfig.adapters.json tsconfig.local.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:core && tsx --test tests/contracts.test.ts tests/core/*.test.ts tests/ui/*.test.ts tests/desktop/unit.test.ts tests/desktop/local-unit.test.ts
scripts.test:local: npm run build:core && tsx --test tests/core/local-*.test.ts tests/desktop/local-unit.test.ts
